versions.content: NULL pointer checking If the detection of development errors is a ctive for this BSW Module (see SWS_BSW_00042 ), then pointer parameters shall be checked against NULL_PTR unless NULL_PTR is explicitly allowed as a valid pointer address value in the API parameter specification. The same also applies in case a structure address is passed for the structure's field(s). If such a violation is detected a development error shall be raised.
